plan_item: 77.44.7.B — native keyboard selection across Rich Text blocks
finding: The latest Rich Text evidence covered native mouse selection across paragraphs and list items, mobile browser selection, IME composition, paste, and backward anchor/focus restoration. It did not separately exercise native Shift+Arrow selection across paragraphs or browser Undo/Redo restoration of that selected range.
change: Added a focused real-Chromium test that places a caret, creates forward and backward multi-paragraph ranges with native Shift+ArrowRight/Shift+ArrowLeft keyboard input, and checks the canonical Page Model segments and direction.

The test applies inline marks through the existing Inspector command and verifies that its DOM rerender retains selection text and direction. Actual Editor Undo/Redo each rerender the complete UI; Undo removes only the last inline mark while preserving backward selection, and Redo restores the mark and selection.
Real Editor Undo removes only the last applied mark and Redo restores it; both full Editor rerenders retain the cross-paragraph native selection and backward direction.
The desktop mock-API lifecycle verifies draft Save does not publish, a later explicit Publish does, and the public renderer outputs the same selected inline marks.
Regenerated the existing 396-feature source-candidate crosswalk so this new browser test appears under the existing Editor acceptance candidates. No runtime source changed.
